content: Mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà Dweelà a Nzam
Lalan, apanà, ikwàndwà ifàkal anki ntɔn baar abà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Ntɔn un'kɔɔn a Dweelà awafàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, kàman'tsuuŋ unsà un'kɔɔn a man'be anà ukwà.

Ntɔn undiir kàkäl mpay mukyer unsà un'kɔɔn, ntɔn un'sön kun'kwaamà ngwal, Nzam kàkyer akyer wa: ntɔn man'be, Nde kàtöm Mwan ande ŋakwo u ndür ayà asànaa ndür a man'be, nde kàpɛ ikwàndwà akà man'be unsà un'sön.
Kàkyer nde abà ntɔn balàbal alà kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà un'kɔɔn làkwey amu bi, bi baar mpa ifàyikyà ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b a un'sön, wɛɛ unsà Dweelà.
Abun sye, ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b a un'sön, an'kyän aba màfàsyääl imbuur, wɛɛ baar abà ungyɛl a Dweelà, an'kyän aba màfàsyääl yin'kyɛɛl.
Ntɔn un'sön afàsyen kà ukwà, wɛɛ Dweelà afàsyen u mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà u duu.
Ntɔn an'kyän a un'sön màfàmbäär Nzam, ma màfàkal anki ungyɛl a un'kɔɔn a Nzam, ma màkwo anki akà ikikye.
Kyekà, baar bàfàkal ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b a un'sön, ba bàkwe anki mupà Nzam un'sak.
Wɛɛ akà bɛ, bɛ làbà anki unsà un'sön, wɛɛ unsà Dweelà, isàkal naa ndandaa Dweelà a Nzam wà anà bɛ. Isàkal naa mbuur watɛy anà Dweelà a Klistɔ, nde kà wà mbuur ande anki.
Abun, isàkal naa Klistɔ wà amu bɛ, ndür abɛ, ndandaa, yà ndür aŋàkwà ntɔn man'be, wɛɛ Dweelà wà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ ntɔn balàbal.
Isàkal naa Dweelà a Nzam awà kàwiiy Yɛsu uboo a akü wà uboo a bɛ, mbuur awà kàwiiy Yɛsu Klistɔ uboo a akü asàpà sye mɔ̈ɔ̈ u ndür abɛ yà ukwà yi, u mbwo a Dweelà ande alà uboo a bɛ.
Abun, atɔŋ amɛ, bi ibye anà nkul, wɛɛ kà yà un'sön anki ntɔn mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a imbuur.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa bɛ làbà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ unsà imbuur, bɛ làkyer asàkwà, wɛɛ isàkal naa unsà Dweelà, bɛ lan'dwa nkääl abɛ yà imbuur, apan bɛ làsàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyakin, baar abà bàfasyeen unsà Dweelà a Nzam, ba bà baan a Nzam.
Ntɔn bɛ làwɛl anki dweelà làmwɛy lan'kwo mubuul bɛ asɔ anà mukàlapà bɔɔmà, wɛɛ Dweelà mwɛy afàlabuul bàŋàywaaŋ nkà, waa anà bi ikuub in'kwɛŋ: « Wɔɔ Taa! »
Dweelà nde ŋakwo afàtà imbäl akà dweelà abi naa bi ibà baan a Nzam.
Abun, ntɔn bi ibà baan, bi sye ibà akyee a kwal: akyee a Nzam anà akyee a kwal mbwo mwɛy anà Klistɔ, ntɔn bi ban'wal yar unsà mpay ande, bi sye isàwal yar unsà làkoo ande.
Làkɔɔ làyàyà
Mɛ in'yweerà naa mpay a taaŋ alà ikwo anki anà làkoo alà làyàmɛnà amu bi.
Ntɔn, nkyeer yanswà yàmudilà anà nkääŋ a mpem mɛɛy a baan a Nzam.
Ntɔn, nkyeer yanswà yàŋàbilà ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b a bunàbun, kà unsà ukwen aya anki, wɛɛ unsà ukwen a mbuur kàsi ya, wɛɛ làkyän làmwo:
ntɔn ya sye iyàfàkal anki kà isɔ a küüb ntɔn muwal yar a nsaay anà làkoo a baan a Nzam.
Abun, bi ikyàyöb naa nkyeer yanswà tii lalà yà unsà mpay asànaa usaay a bɔr.
Kà ntɔn ya mpɛl anki: bi sye, bi baar ibye anà mbɛŋ atàtwɛb yà Dweelà, bi ibàmulaal u mpem abi, mudilà ngywaaŋ a nkà, ntsüüŋ a ndür abi.

Ntɔn bi kàkyàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ya yà unsà làkyän mpɛl. Abun, làkyän imanà bi là la kà làkyän anki. Kyekà, uman undiir bàsyeelà làkyän ifàkal nsyeel a làkyän anki: làkyän bàfàsà aben unsà undiir akamɛnà?
Wɛɛ usà làkyän unsà undiir mpa ikamanà bi, yà mudil wa unsà muküünà.
Ifà imwɛy sye, Dweelà làfàyà mukibay unsà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là abi, ntɔn bi iyöb anki muyamà ubwaŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ Dweelà ŋakwo afàyamà ntɔn bi mulaal unsà ngɔk mpa ukwo mbuur mutwey.
Waa mbuur awà afàleŋ muyöb mpem akyàyöb an'kyän a Dweelà, ntɔn Dweelà afàyamà ntɔn baar in'kyɛɛl asànaa ukwen Nzam.
Bi ikyàyöb sye naa indiir byanswà byàfàlyaaŋ ntɔn ubwaŋ a baar bàkwen Nzam, anà baar kàbel nde ntɔn nswaal ande.
Ntɔn, baar abà kàyöb nde kusà, nde ba sye katsüül mukal bàbalàbal kà isii a Mwan ande, ntɔn naa nde awà ukäl nswɛm uboo a atɔŋ mbɔɔn.
Baar abà kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n nde fà itaan, nde kàkyer abel sye, baar kàbel nde, nde ba kabuul bàbalàbal sye, anà ba akwà kàbuul nde bàbalàbal, nde kàkyer asyäŋà sye.
Abun, ininà bi ifàtɛn ntɔn indiir abi? Isàkal naa Nzam wà anà bi, nà asimbäär?
Abun, nde mbuur mpa kàtii Mwan ande ŋakwo, wɛɛ nde kun'käb ntɔn bi banswà, ntɔn nkye mpa kipà nde, mbwo mwɛy anà Mwan ande, indiir byanswà?
Nà kan'kwo mufüün baar abà kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Nzam? Nzam afàtwey baar balàbal!
Nà asatsüül mbar? Klistɔ Yɛsu kàkyàkwà, waa kàfàwiyà, nde wà u kɔɔ a ibaal a Nzam, wàmubɔɔn ntɔn bi!
Nà asàkaab bi anà ukwen a Klistɔ? Lingyoomà, ngyɛb, nkwaaŋ, ngyal, làmbwà, kɔm itàkal igɔnsà?
Asànaa bàsön naa:

content.text: « Ntɔn ngye, bi bàkidwa ilä aŋukiinà,
ba bàfiwal asànaa ntsür bàfàsyen kà idwääl. »

content: Wɛɛ unsà ayi yanswà, bi ibà aŋàböŋ aŋàsöönà u mbwo a mbuur awà kikwen.
Ɛɛ, ndandaa mɛ an'sà kam naa itàkal ukwà, itàkal mɔ̈ɔ̈, itàkal akyeey, itàkal amfum, itàkal papanà, itàkal taaŋ làsàyà, itàkal ngwal,
itàkal ngwal a du, itàkal ngwal a ngyɛl a mɛɛn, itàkal nkyeer asin, undiir mwɛy tɛy akaab bi anà ukwen a Nzam bàyàmɛnà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu awà Mwol abi.
